import pathlib,json,hashlib,subprocess
r=pathlib.Path('/home/n4s5ti/Documents/dev/fl0sint')
m=json.loads((r/'docs/audits/DEF-41/manifest.json').read_text())
checks={}
for key in ['source_sha256','configuration_sha256']:
 checks[key]={p:hashlib.sha256((r/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in m[key].items()}
shared={}
for line in (r/'docs/audits/DEF-41/raw/pre/main-gitnexus-hashes.txt').read_text().splitlines():
 h,p=line.removeprefix('SHA256=').split(' FILE=',1)
 shared[p]=hashlib.sha256((r/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h
checks['shared_index']=shared
checks['git_head']=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=r,text=True).strip()
checks['working_delta']=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'],cwd=r,text=True)
checks['pip3r_runtime_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('/home/n4s5ti/Documents/dev/pip3r/packages/runtime/dist/bin/pip3r.js').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
checks['pip3r_version']=subprocess.check_output(['pip3r','--version'],text=True).strip()
assert all(all(v.values()) for k,v in checks.items() if isinstance(v,dict))
print(json.dumps(checks,indent=2))
